description: BBB frame codec: 4-byte big-endian length prefix + payload; plugin-side limit 1 MiB, daemon-inbound limit 16 MiB
source: BBB_V2_AUDIT.md section 2; sdk/c/src/bbb_transport_posix.c:174-228; sdk/c/src/bbb_transport.h:26-30; sdk/go/aiii/bbb.go:446-495; identity_os: sev_rpc.h:129-130, rpc.c:3524-3549

vectors.name: roundtrip_length_counts_bytes_not_chars
vectors.cite: payload is UTF-8 bytes; 13 chars, 14 bytes (AUDIT 2)

vectors.name: roundtrip_invalid_utf8_is_a_valid_frame
vectors.note: framing performs no UTF-8 validation (AUDIT 2); the JSON layer rejects this payload (bbb_client.c:81-113,303-307; bbb.go:559)

vectors.name: decode_zero_length_frame_is_empty_payload
vectors.note: legal at the framing layer only; the JSON layer rejects empty input and the daemon answers -32700 (AUDIT 2.3)

vectors.name: synthetic_roundtrip_exactly_at_1mib_limit
vectors.cite: limit is inclusive: refused only when len > max (posix.c:179, bbb.go:450)

vectors.name: encode_error_one_byte_over_1mib
vectors.cite: refused before any byte is written (posix.c:179-180; bbb_test.go:428-434)

vectors.name: decode_error_declared_over_1mib
vectors.note: declares 1048577 bytes; receiver errors without reading the payload, stream is unrecoverable (AUDIT 2.2)

vectors.name: decode_error_truncated_header
vectors.cite: EOF mid-header is an I/O error, no resync exists (AUDIT 2.2)

vectors.name: decode_error_truncated_payload
vectors.cite: posix.c:124-125 recv_all sees EOF; io.ReadFull -> ErrUnexpectedEOF

vectors.name: synthetic_roundtrip_2mib_under_daemon_limit
vectors.note: legal daemon-inbound, illegal plugin-side: the asymmetric bound of AUDIT 2.1 / finding F-11

vectors.name: decode_error_declared_over_16mib_daemon_bound
vectors.note: the daemon disconnects the peer on this (rpc.c:3529-3534)
